name: Hogeschool Zeeland (HZ) University of Applied Sciences
overview: HZ University of Applied Sciences, located in the South-West of the Netherlands, is a middle-sized university with around 4,800 students. It consistently ranks in the top three Dutch multidisciplinary universities of applied sciences since 2011. HZ focuses on practice-based education and research, collaborates closely with the business world and research centers, and maintains a global network of partner universities.
administrative:
1) Application Dossier

  • Once the IR office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application.
  • (They can take a lot of time to answer emails.)
  • All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline.
  • (See EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline.)


To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier


2) Visa

  • For European students:
  • A valid passport or national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception: the UK).
  • For non-European students or those with non-European citizenship:
  • Please check the immigration office of the host country to understand the visa process and fees.
Students in France can use this website:
https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/

3) Insurance

For European students:

  • The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM) is nominative and individual.
  • This card certifies your rights to Health Insurance in Europe.
  • To obtain your card:
  • Log in to your Ameli account at least two months before departure
  • It is free of charge and will be sent to your address within two weeks
  • You can also download it online


For more information:

https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger

For non-European students:

  • You must register for private health insurance to cover your full stay.
  • Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance provider depending on the desired coverage.


French citizens only:

Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be informed of any urgent news (e.g. terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake) in your host country:

https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html

courses:
60 ECTS per year

30 ECTS per semester


The list of courses can be found here.


Students should select the faculty of Information & Communication Technology (ICT). The courses are mainly theorical, but you can also have projects to take care of.


The course list is given to you for your information. It can change from year to year. If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible for it.

EIP: Any tech4 abroad involves an EIP! Take advantage of the free slots you will have to advance them.
